messages:
lena: Hey team — we need to schedule a PIR for INC-2026-042 (page storm + DB failover). Looking for a facilitator and a slot that covers EMEA + NA. Tentative windows: Tue 10:00-11:00 PT OR Wed 16:00-17:00 UTC. Who can facilitate? Required: oncall, infra, core-api, product-sre, support/CS. Please +1 preferred slot.

omar: I can facilitate but I'm in an exec briefing Tue 10-11 PT. If we move to Wed 16:00 UTC I can do it. Otherwise I can co-host.

taylor: I can take facilitator if omar is busy. Wed 16:00 UTC works for me. Happy to run agenda and SLO slides.

cheng: Quick timezone check — Wed 16:00 UTC = Wed 9:00 PT / Wed 17:00 CET? can someone confirm conversions pls.

marta: agenda draft in the incident doc: https://rwinf.internal/docs/incidents/INC-2026-042/pir-prep — I'll add CS notes and customer impact bullets.

incidents-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 — Sev2 resolved. MTTR: 32m. Mitigation owner: @sam. Postmortem recommended: yes.

sam: I'll drop the timeline + scrubbed logs into the doc by EOD. Also prepping a 2-slide customer-impact summary.

jess: propose 45m PIR + 15m action triage. I made a quick poll: https://doodle.com/poll/abcd1234 — please add availability.

taylor: +1 for 45/15. I'll prepare the run-of-show. Do we want a 1-slide exec summary for product + infra leads?

omar: yes, short 2-3 bullets. Also suggest pairing facilitator with an ops liaison to own followups.

lena: ops liaison = omar if he can co-host; otherwise sam. Also want someone to own the action tracker in the console.

marta: can @jess own the tracker? she runs action retros.

jess: I can own the tracker. Will create JIRA tickets and tag remediation-label.

cheng: timezone confirmation: Wed 16:00 UTC = Wed 9:00 PT / Wed 17:00 CET — I checked. Put your vote in the poll.

lena: ok looks like Wed 16:00 UTC wins. Facilitator = taylor, co-host/ops liaison = omar. Pre-read due by Tue 23:59 UTC. Attendee ask-list: @oncall, @infra, @core-api, @product-sre, @support-cs, @eng-qa. I'll send calendar invite once we have confirmation.

sam: adding customer impact slide and short summary now. FYI: affected customers list in doc is redacted.

taylor: thanks — drafting agenda now:
```
- 00:00-05:00 intro + scope
- 05:00-20:00 timeline review
- 20:00-35:00 root cause discussion
- 35:00-45:00 actions / owners
- 45:00-60:00 overflow
```

lena: tagging action items here:
- taylor: prep agenda + facilitator notes
- sam: timeline + slides
- jess: action tracker + JIRA tickets
- marta: CS impact notes
- omar: co-host + followup owner

omar: ack, I'll own followups if I co-host.

taylor: ack. Invite pls when ready.

incidents-bot: Calendar invite created by lena for Wed 16:00 UTC. Link: https://calendar.internal/evt/xyz

lena: thanks all — closing this thread for now. Will ping if anything changes. :thumbsup:
